glossary.definition:
(A) "Applicable generally accepted accounting principles" means accounting principles and standards set forth in all applicable pronouncements of the governmental accounting standards board.

(B) "Cable service," "cable system," "franchise," and "franchising authority" have the same meanings as in the "Telecommunications Act of 1996," Pub. L. No. 104-104, Title III, Sections 301(a) and 302 (b)(2), 110 Stat. 114, 124, 47 U.S.C.A. 522.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition:
(C) "Cable service provider" means any person or group of persons that is engaged in the provision of cable service over a cable system and directly or indirectly owns a significant interest in the cable system, or that through any arrangement otherwise controls or is responsible for the management and operation of the cable system.

(D) "Color of office," "public office," and "public official" have the same meanings as in section 117.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Direct costs" means all costs, whether capital costs, operating costs, or otherwise, that would be eliminated if the service or function to which they relate were discontinued.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Full cost accounting" means, in accordance with applicable generally accepted accounting principles, accounting for all direct and indirect costs, including capital costs, that are incurred in the ownership, management, or operation of a cable system or provision of cable service over a cable system.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "Indirect costs" means all costs, whether capital costs, operating costs, or otherwise, that are not direct costs. Indirect costs that support multiple services or functions shall be allocated among those services and functions in proportion to the relative burden each service or function places on the cost category and by any reasonable method consistent with applicable generally accepted accounting principles.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Person" includes any individual, corporation, partnership, limited liability company, association, trust, or political subdivision.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Private cable service provider" means any cable service provider other than a public cable service provider.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Private cable service regulation" means any regulation, rule, requirement, or restriction of or by a political subdivision of this state that applies, by resolution, ordinance, rule, regulation, franchising agreement, or otherwise, to the terms and conditions of service, conditions of access to public property, permits for pole attachments, or any other matter concerning or affecting the provision of cable service over a cable system by a private cable service provider.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Public cable service provider" means any cable service provider that is a political subdivision of this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.

glossary.definition: (L) "Public cable service recipient" means any household or business that receives cable service or benefits from video programming service, transmission service, distribution service, repair service, billing service, or customer service that is provided by, originates from, or is controlled by a public cable service provider of a political subdivision.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1332.01 to 1332.10 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 1332.01 - Fair competition in cable operations definitions.
